en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Still thinking about Miu's confession,
I couldn't come up with a plan...

Hah-haha! Hey Shuichi, why the sad, miserable
face!?

<CLT=cltMIND>I guess I was the only one
worried about it.

Since you look so bummed out, I got you
a present!
Is it...another invention?

Hah! What a crazy idea!
I almost feel sorry for you!

I, Miu Iruma, will show you just how versatile
I really am! So here, take this!
Is this...a pie?

Yep! It's an apple pie!
I baked it from scratch myself!

<CLT=cltMIND>I didn't think she would
bring me a pie...

<CLT=cltMIND>And it looks really professional.
Miu must be a pretty good cook.

<CLT=cltMIND>Impressed, I inspected the pie.
That's when I found...

Ah...Miu?
Is this...a hair?

Hah-hahaha! Don't worry!
I added some hidden ingredients!

"Don't worry"!?
I'm gonna worry about hair in my food!
Hngh...
B-But...I just want the person I like to eat me...

I-I made more, too... Cookies with my
fingernails... Chocolates with my blood...

<CLT=cltMIND>...Well, at the very least, it means
that her confession was genuine.

<CLT=cltMIND>But she's, ah...
coming on a little strong.

<CLT=cltMIND>Uh oh, she's staring at me!
She wants me to eat it!

Ah, um, I'm really...honored that you made this
for me, but I'm concerned about the hygiene...

And there are no hospitals around here,
so we have to be careful...
Hah! You got a lotta balls to lecture me!

But y'know, even a genius like me should be
more careful with the stuff I make!

If anything happened to you...I might...
go crazy...

I-If that happened, the world would never
recover! Right!? Isn't that right!?
Y-Yeah?

Oh well! I'll just hafta make you something
else!
What?
Hah-ha! The time has finally come to use this!

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu whipped out the
ray gun from earlier.
Time to go commando!
<CLT=cltMIND>She took aim, and then...
A-Ah!

<CLT=cltMIND>A piece of fabric suddenly
materialized in my hand!

<CLT=cltMIND>If I remember correctly...
I think I know what this is...

Whaddaya think of that, Shuichi!?
Can you feel my residual heat?
<CLT=cltMIND>...Yes! Yes, I can!

You get it now? You've earned the right
to date me!
I've what!?

When we get outta here, you're goin' on a
date with me! Got it!? It's already decided!
It is!?

Duh-doy! If you go on a date with me, I'll
just explode with excitement!

If you turn me down, the world will never
recover! Understand?

You're the only guy in the world who's
ever made me feel this good!

So you better take responsibility for what
you've done! Hah-hahahahaha!

<CLT=cltMIND>This is how Miu expresses
her feelings, I see.
Alright... I understand.

Hahahaaaaa! It's a date! You promised!
Better not forget!
Ah, haha...

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu smiled, but I returned it with
something more akin to a grimace.

<CLT=cltMIND>But at the same time...
She is showing me a lot of affection.

<CLT=cltMIND>I am happy that I was able to make
this kind of connection with Miu.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm a little...ah, no, *very* nervous
about this, but still...

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure it will be okay.
We'll get out of here, together!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Miu's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've learned a new skill,
<CLT=cltSTRONG>XXX-Ray Goggles<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltMIND>I then spent some time listening to
Miu's delusional date ideas...
